tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, the sidebar, inputs. One step up from bg.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inset notes inside a panel, such as stop instructions.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Active nav item, selected row, status chip ground for neutral-blue states.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel outlines and dividers between rows. Use lines, not extra cards.

tokens.name: border-input
tokens.usage: Search fields and segmented controls.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, dashed free-slot outlines on the dispatch board.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on bg or surface.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Nav items, detail lines, secondary values.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels above values, timestamps, helper text. Passes 4.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one main button per screen, current stop marker, today in date pickers. White text on it.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links, active nav icon, suggested-assignment text, on-time ETAs.

tokens.name: load-fill
tokens.usage: Load blocks on the dispatch board.

tokens.name: load-border
tokens.usage: Outline of load blocks and blue status chips.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Only for something wrong or at risk: late, overdue, offline. Always with words, never color alone.

tokens.name: warning-fill
tokens.usage: Ground of a late load block or offline badge.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Outline of warning badges.

tokens.name: neutral-fill
tokens.usage: Non-load time on the board, such as home time.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Big numbers in the summary strip.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text in the office app.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small label above a value, in text-muted.

styles.name: driver-body
styles.usage: Driver app text, one step larger for a glance at a dock.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Money in tables and the load money panel, so digits line up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and between board blocks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside rows and toolbars.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding (vertical) and driver app card gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel side padding and gaps between panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Page side padding in the office app.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Load blocks, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Driver app cards and the big driver button.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Status chips and badges.
